package: K27/R16 partial: export route against disposable PostgreSQL

database.cleanup: Synthetic records were deleted by test teardown; disposable container was stopped and removed. No existing Polutek container or database was used.

route_observations: Real GET route handler returned 200 JSON download with Cache-Control no-store and Content-Disposition.
Exported rows came from the synthetic actor's own account; foreign user's comment, creator, views, sessions, and events were absent.
Playback IP/UA hashes and event metadata/error text were absent; owned avatar/banner, channel membership, patron grant, and notification categories were returned.
An invalid account pass setting became null; a repeat export returned 200 with the same own comment rows.
Guest actor was rejected with 401 before the rate limiter ran.
controlled_boundaries: The actual Next route handler and PostgreSQL-backed Prisma queries were used, but auth identity and rate limiter were mocked.
The test invoked the handler directly; it did not start a Next HTTP server or validate a real session cookie.
No R2, email provider, payment provider, production data, or remote server was used.
limitations: K27-T1/T2 remain partial until full Next HTTP with a real signed/revoked session, broader seeded categories, and independent review.
K37 export size/streaming is still open; account policy dependencies K05/K11/K26 remain.
